caption: The drawing is a black-and-white line illustration depicting a wrought iron altar railing. The composition is centered on a highly ornate, symmetrical railing structure that consists of two main panels. Each panel features intricate scrollwork and a central circular motif containing a cross with radiating lines. The railing is supported by decorative balusters on either end and between the two panels, each baluster embellished with elaborate foliage and floral designs. Behind the railing, there is a raised altar area. On top of the altar are seven candlesticks with lit candles, evenly spaced, and a central tabernacle-like structure flanked by floral arrangements. Four statues, two on each side, are positioned further back on the altar, each standing on pedestals. The background consists of architectural detailing in the form of columns and arches. The drawing is monochromatic, using only black ink on a beige or cream-colored paper. The height of the railing is marked as “42.5” to the right, and the label "WROUGHT IRON ALTAR RAILING" appears at the bottom right of the image.
title: Altar Railing
